description: This PHP source file defines a REST API endpoint class `TimesheetProjectActivityUniqueValidationAPI` within the OrangeHRM system. The class provides an API method `getOne()` to validate the uniqueness of a project activity within a timesheet, by checking for duplicates based on provided parameters such as timesheet ID, activity ID, and project ID. It includes input validation rules and leverages traits for timesheet-related services and permissions.
